newsitem.title: USA: Premier Laser sees Q3 sales $1.4-$1.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Premier Laser sees Q3 sales $1.4-$1.6 mln.

text.p: Premier Laser Systems said on Monday it expected to report sales in the range of $1.4 million to $1.6 million for its fiscal third quarter ending December 31.
The company said the projected sales is double the sales from the comparable quarter in 1995.
The company's chairman, president and chief executive, Colette Cozean, said there have been substantial increases in orders of Diode, Erbium:YAG and Argon lasers, principally for dental applications.
The company also said it expects a record backlog of orders entering the fourth quarter, including a backlog for its argon lasers which is expected to reach about $1 million by January 1, 1997.

Premier Laser said it develops, manufactures and markets several lines of proprietary medical lasers, fiber optic delivery systems and associated products for a variety of dental, ophthalmic, surgical and dermatological applications.
